driver_note: driver_sha256 is the measure.py that ran (the "guard the #1507 driver" commit). The committed file was later changed for ruff only (Path.open, explicit check=False, helpers instead of lambdas); an S12 smoke run reproduced the same external/spilling partition counts.
post_measurement_source_changes: The "satisfy clippy for the #1507 spill spike" commit refactors the spike (boxed variant, checked casts, split setup helpers); the storage suite passed unchanged after it. Measurements used the binary built on main 3b514cd8 before that refactor.
